# `aitbc network subscribers`

List all active subscribers, optionally filtered by chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network subscribers [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Filter by chain ID |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network subscribers
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network subscribers --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
